Name: Linus
Summary: Linus was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Eubulus, Pudens, and Claudia.
KeyStory: Linus was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Eubulus, Pudens, and Claudia.
LifeLesson: Standing by in the last days of a ministry is faithfulness to the end.
